name: How much does water leak detection typically cost?

mainEntity.name: How much does water leak detection typically cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of water leak detection can vary depending on several factors, including the complexity of the leak, the equipment required, and the time it takes to locate. Some companies charge a flat fee, while others may charge by the hour. It's advisable to get a detailed estimate upfront. Keep in mind that the cost of detection is often much less than the cost of repairing extensive water damage if a leak is left undetected.
acceptedAnswer.description: Leak detection costs vary based on complexity and time. It's often less expensive than repairing extensive water damage.
